title: Credit Risk & Lending Decisions
focus: Financial ML, credit risk and model validation
evidence: 30,000 public Taiwan card-client records; identical 18,007-client training budgets; 6,001-client holdout; separate calibration/policy partitions and duplicate-input isolation.
bullets: Compared training-only WoE/logistic and histogram boosting on 30,000 public credit-card records; isolated duplicate inputs across four splits with equal 18,007-client training budgets and a 6,001-client holdout.
Measured AUC 0.7814/0.7897; paired group-bootstrap difference 95% CI [0.0006, 0.0161]. Calibration and assumed decision-cost advantages remained uncertain; retained all holdout predictions.
limit: One historical Taiwan cohort and earlier South German study; not out-of-time validation or regulatory PD/ECL. No observed LGD/EAD; decision costs illustrative.

prior_evidence.evidence: 1,000 corrected UCI observations; 200-row holdout; paired model uncertainty and a frozen lending-policy audit.
bullets: Built a training-only WoE/logistic scorecard and random-forest challenger on 1,000 corrected UCI credit records; evaluated discrimination, calibration and illustrative stress losses on a 200-row holdout.
Audited paired model uncertainty: challenger AUC advantage 0.023, 95% CI [-0.014, 0.061]; exposed unequal training sizes and tested assumed prevalence shifts without refitting the holdout.
prior_evidence.limit: Small historical oversampled dataset, no observation dates; IFRS 9/LGD/EAD assumptions are illustrative.

latest_evidence_release.scope: One historical Taiwan cohort and earlier South German study; not out-of-time validation or regulatory PD/ECL. No observed LGD/EAD; decision costs illustrative.

title: Causal Decision Science
evidence: 64,000 randomized customers; reconciled 12,800-row evaluation; same-budget targeting gain 0.946 percentage points, conditional 95% CI [0.333, 1.561].
bullets: Analysed a 64,000-customer randomized email experiment with 5,000 bootstrap resamples and Holm correction; selected a T-learner using a fixed train/validation/evaluation split.

Reconciled same-budget policy value on 12,800 evaluation records: +0.946 percentage points in visits versus random 30% targeting, conditional 95% CI [0.333, 1.561]; retained the failed spend-heterogeneity result.
limit: Public retrospective evaluation; uncertainty is conditional on the fitted ranking. No profit or individual-treatment-effect claim.

title: Financial AI Evidence Systems
focus: Applied AI, retrieval evaluation and reliable numerical tools
evidence: 883-question FinQA retrieval comparison; 33 financial reconciliations and seven refusal controls; completed actual Qwen3-4B output audit on 128 frozen public-test questions.
bullets: Benchmarked TF-IDF, BM25 and reciprocal-rank fusion on 883 FinQA development questions; TF-IDF retrieved all labelled evidence in the top three for 61.4%, with per-question outputs and pinned source identity.

Built a source-linked financial calculator with 33 reconciliations and 7 refusal controls; audited actual Qwen3-4B outputs on 128 frozen questions, exposing arithmetic, source-selection and answer-scale failures.
limit: Calculator has a bounded company/year/metric/unit contract. General FinQA answers remain experimental and unreliable; citation occurrence does not prove semantic entailment.

prior_evidence.evidence: 883 FinQA development questions; 3 retrievers; 33 numerical reconciliations and 7 unsupported-request controls.
bullets: Benchmarked TF-IDF, BM25 and reciprocal-rank fusion on 883 FinQA development questions; TF-IDF retrieved all labelled evidence in the top three for 61.4%, with per-question outputs and pinned source identity.
Built a source-linked numerical tool layer for public financial filings; passed 33 reconciliations and 7 refusal controls for unsupported periods, entities, metrics, units and extra instructions.
prior_evidence.limit: FinQA evaluation measures within-report retrieval, not end-to-end answer accuracy. The original small-model RAG study remains separately documented.

latest_evidence_release.scope: Calculator has a bounded company/year/metric/unit contract. General FinQA answers remain experimental and unreliable; citation occurrence does not prove semantic entailment.

title: Actuarial Risk Modelling
focus: Employee benefits, claims reserving and uncertainty
evidence: Published RAA triangle; independently reproduced 9 rounded Mack standard errors; 22 later-diagonal forecasts; Excel/Python benefits model.
bullets: Implemented Mack reserving from a published 55-cell RAA triangle; reproduced nine external standard-error references and evaluated 22 later-diagonal forecasts against a no-development baseline.
Built a formula-driven Excel/Python benefits model with synthetic employee and claims data; added stochastic-reserving controls to the existing workbook validation, for 12 passing model tests.
limit: RAA is a historical reinsurance benchmark, not health-client data. Benefits valuation uses synthetic proxies and is not an IAS 19/ASC 715 valuation.

title: Derivatives & Hedging Model Risk
focus: Numerical calibration, pricing diagnostics and hedging
evidence: 466 filtered BTC option observations, 6 expiries; 27 common-path hedge/cost/volatility scenarios across 3,000 simulated paths.
bullets: Calibrated constrained raw-SVI smiles on 466 filtered BTC option observations across six expiries; compared held-out-strike predictions with a quadratic baseline and retained fit-support diagnostics.
Extended hedge validation to 27 volatility/frequency/cost scenarios on 3,000 common GBM paths, including initial and terminal trading costs, turnover and Monte Carlo uncertainty.
limit: One historical crypto-option snapshot and controlled GBM simulation; no global arbitrage-free or profitable-trading claim.

latest_evidence_release.scope: Frozen-parameter density/extrapolation and split audit; explicit bounded API; no global or observed-market arbitrage claim

title: C++20 Event-Driven Trading Engine
evidence: 25,000-event independent matching oracle; another 25,000-event recovery study with 685 restores, 1,304 bit-flip/163 truncation refusals; independent portable-format decoder.
bullets: Built a C++20 price-time-priority matching and deterministic replay engine with partial cancellations and marketable limit orders; historical same-runner benchmark reduced event time from 145.1 ns to 104.1 ns.
Verified every fill against an independent oracle across 25,000 events; validated 685 snapshot restores across another 25,000 events, corruption/FIFO guards and ASan/UBSan checks.
limit: Synthetic replay; historic platform-specific timing. Recovery is an in-memory image API, not a durable exchange journal, live feed or production service.

prior_evidence.evidence: 25,000 randomized events; 5 seeds; every fill and all 256 order-ID slots checked against an independent vector-based oracle.
bullets: Built a C++20 price-time-priority matching and deterministic replay engine with partial cancellations and marketable limit orders; historical same-runner benchmark reduced event time from 145.1 ns to 104.1 ns.
Added independent differential verification across 25,000 randomized events and five seeds, checking fills, prices, quantities and all order-ID slots after each event; passed ASan/UBSan checks.
prior_evidence.limit: Synthetic replay and platform-specific historical benchmark; not live exchange latency or production trading.

latest_evidence_release.scope: Synthetic replay; historic platform-specific timing. Recovery is an in-memory image API, not a durable exchange journal, live feed or production service.

title: Data Engineering & Decision Optimisation
focus: Large-scale data processing and constrained optimisation
evidence: 24.08m-trip PySpark study and independent optimization oracles; later-period 6,003 July zone-days from 3.90m additional raw trips; frozen mean MAE 5.79 versus zero baseline 12.40.
bullets: Processed 24.08m NYC taxi trips with PySpark into a complete weekday zone panel; constrained rebalancing reduced proxy vehicle-miles by 3.76% versus a distance-aware greedy baseline.
Checked 100 transport cases, including 40 exhaustive oracles; validated frozen flow means on 6,003 later-month zone-days: MAE 5.79 versus 12.40 for a zero-flow sanity baseline.
limit: Trip flow is not idle supply, centroid distance is a proxy. One later month/zero comparator is not frontier forecasting or realized dispatch savings.

prior_evidence.evidence: 24.08m raw TLC trips; complete zero-inclusive zone panel; 100 offline transport cases including 40 exhaustive oracle comparisons.
bullets: Processed 24.08m NYC taxi trips with PySpark into a complete weekday zone panel; constrained rebalancing reduced proxy vehicle-miles by 3.76% versus a distance-aware greedy baseline.
Implemented a dependency-light transport solver and verified 100 cases, including 40 exhaustive small-network comparisons; checked integrality, capacity and quantity conservation.
prior_evidence.limit: TLC trip flow does not observe idle fleet supply; centroid distance is a proxy, and allocation is a static model.

latest_evidence_release.scope: Trip flow is not idle supply, centroid distance is a proxy. One later month/zero comparator is not frontier forecasting or realized dispatch savings.
